name: corpus_max_source_share
description: No single source may dominate a primary partition: the largest source's share of any of train/val/hard_dev rows must be <= 0.30. Rejects a split where validation CE would mostly measure one document's style (e.g. the 68% single-source val share that motivated this gate). Threshold is configurable; 0.30 still rejects dominance by a wide margin while tolerating the cap/partition rounding artifact (500/1993 = 0.2509).
